surface: Daily Quest selection, reward continuity, domain doors, Journal materials, Focus playback reliability
scope: Continue Build 41 as the full application foundation and preserve later experimental code. Improve the real daily loop while retaining the room, RPG depth and complete destinations.
user_job: Make a small real action, feel its immediate consequence, see what it contributes to, and return without losing prior work.

active_sources.judged_state: Owner rejects the separate study's appearance and loss of depth, authorizes continuing from Build 41 or later work using Sol agents, and asks to retain useful improvements.
The complete existing product, with authored room materials, dense useful behavior and real production input.

superseded_sources.reason: Owner rejected its sparse composition, colored panels and loss of product depth. Its visual system is not a source for this continuation.

product.decision: Selection is free; only a named action enters the existing completion or special-action path. Link actual earned progress to domain and Goal context.
product.proof: Exact-row selection, no XP on selection, one explicit completion, truthful goal status and preserved later writing.

interaction.decision: Keep the Build 41 completion choreography and full destinations. Recover focus playback reliably without changing saved music preferences.
interaction.proof: Real daily journey plus cancellation, repeat input, undo, focus retry/background and reduced-motion checks.

visual.decision: Preserve the authored room; reduce competing frames; make dark Journal materials coherent; use restrained pigments and one clear primary action.
visual.proof: Same-input baseline and candidate renders, full-frame inspection, narrow and large text plus actual browser interaction.

unverified_property: Owner judgment of beauty and depth, physical phone feel, sound balance and long-session fatigue; automatic domain history is still a short recent buffer.

decisive_check.method: Use the full app locally through the daily journey and compare fresh production fixtures, then review on a physical phone.
decisive_check.pass_condition: All preserved destinations work, actions and rewards remain honest, writing survives later edits, the composition reads coherently, and owner/device acceptance is recorded separately.
